# Design

Events: an additive events(seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, at, kind, subject, run, node, branch, payload) table, fed by triggers on the durable tables, a kvx status hook, and explicit events_emit calls, with events_since for readers; every fleet, spec, and supervisor transition emits. Serve: a serve module reuses the MCP tool dispatch behind a JSON-RPC stdio loop with subscribe and unsubscribe; it wakes on the WAL file's change (inotify on Linux, stat fallback elsewhere) and reads events_since with a read transaction only. Drivers: a drivers module owns argv building (moved from orchestrate.c) and parses claude stream-json and codex exec --json into agent events; unknown drivers keep plain logs. Supervisor: fleet_runs and fleet_nodes tables hold the run; cg fleet up forks a detached supervisor that owns a tick loop (reap, progress, budgets, retries, escalation, approvals, spawn) and writes a pid file; --resume reattaches to live pids by checking /proc and the recorded start time. Slots become per task on task branches cut from the feature branch; merge-up takes a merge lock on the feature worktree. The main agent is a real driver process woken on feature completion, escalation, and checkpoint. Context: a task packet builder composes spec criteria, graph lookups (symbol definitions, callers, callees), required-task evidence resolved on the feature branch, recall, and live sibling touches, fitted to the context budget; work update gains an upstream delta. Drift: a drift module computes spec drift from the attempt diff against declared symbols and touches, collision prediction from touches plus impact over declared symbols, interface drift from cross-branch refs in the unified graph after each merge, and requirement coverage from trace. Extension: a client over cg serve replaces execFile and the poll timers; views apply events to local models; the fleet view and chat subscribe per agent; slash commands come from tools/list. Everything stays in the one binary on libc and libsqlite3.
